company.description:
Manticore Games develops Core, a platform and community to build, share, and play online games.

Manticore Games was started by industry veterans with experience in PC, console, mobile, and VR games.

It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in San Mateo, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Manticore Games is researching tools to streamline game creation workflows. In Programmatically configuring materials, described as improved texturing processes utilizing smart materials for multi dimensional environments, they develop systems where creators generate objects, select smart materials, and programmatically manipulate those materials to improve texturing efficiency. Their work centers on smart material configuration and automated texturing for three dimensional game environments.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $100,812,151, or 62.69% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,677,737 to $726,529,447, a 108.8x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
